audience.text: Developers needing metadata-safe PSD/PSB inspection and limited structural editing in .NET without rendering or raster editing.

capabilities.text: Load PSD and supported PSB files from file paths and stream sources using the public API surface.
capabilities.title: Load PSD/PSB from file and stream

capabilities.text: Read document-level metadata including Width, Height, ChannelsCount, BitsPerChannel, ColorMode, Version, Size, Bounds, Compression, ImageResources, and IsFlatten.
capabilities.title: Read document metadata

capabilities.text: Read and modify layer properties such as Name, Bounds, Width, Height, Top, Left, Bottom, Right, IsVisible, Opacity, Clipping, and BlendModeKey.
capabilities.title: Read and modify layer metadata

capabilities.text: Preserve unsupported sections of PSD/PSB files as raw bytes during save operations, ensuring minimal data loss.
capabilities.title: Preserve unsupported sections

capabilities.text: Save updated PSD/PSB files without rendering pixels, supporting metadata-only workflows.
capabilities.title: Save without rendering

limitations.text: The library does not render PSD/PSB content or support pixel editing.
It does not interpret the full Photoshop feature set semantically or replace the commercial Aspose.PSD API one-to-one.
Export to raster formats like PNG or JPEG is not supported.
Full image resource editing and semantic recognition of specific resource kinds are out of scope.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and modifying supported layer metadata—such as name, visibility, opacity, clipping, blend mode, and geometry—while preserving unsupported sections as raw bytes.
Provides a compact public API to inspect document properties like dimensions, color mode, compression, and image resources without rendering pixels.
Supports saving updated PSD/PSB files without rendering, preserving file integrity for unsupported structures.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD.FOSS is a free open-source .NET library for loading, inspecting, editing a small subset of PSD/PSB metadata, and saving the file back without rendering.

uncertainties: Whether the package is published to NuGet or only available via local build is unclear from the fact set.
The exact set of supported image resources beyond high-level summaries is not specified.
Whether text, vector, effects, smart filters, and adjustment layers are supported is not stated.
The behavior of coordinate transformations for layer geometry is not detailed.
Whether PSB files beyond the currently supported subset are fully compatible is not confirmed.
The extent of raw-byte preservation for corrupted or malformed sections is not defined.
The version compatibility of PSD/PSB files generated by this library with other tools is not stated.
Whether the library supports multi-threaded or concurrent access to the same file is not specified.

workflows.name: Inspect PSD/PSB structure
workflows.text: Load PSD/PSB from file paths or streams and read document properties such as Width, Height, ChannelsCount, BitsPerChannel, ColorMode, and Version.

workflows.name: Enumerate and edit layers
workflows.text: Enumerate layers and modify supported properties including Name, IsVisible, Opacity, Clipping, BlendModeKey, and geometry via coordinate properties.

workflows.name: Save without rendering
workflows.text: Save updated PSD/PSB files back to disk or streams without rendering pixels, preserving unsupported sections as raw bytes where possible.
